purpose: Generic resident numerical runtime tested with the complete existing organism; no anatomical or tolerance fitting.
prerequisite: Preserve exact effective operator across cold reconstruction. Test continuous, cold-rebuilt, and failure-rebuilt paths; failed body sessions remain failed.

A.operation: Independent adaptive clocks on declared independent state blocks inside a coupling epoch; device-owned trial/accept/reject and physical event commits. One slow cell no longer constrains all cells and no host synchronization per internal trial.
A.information: Same initial states, geometry and held inputs; same declared coupling boundaries, error budgets and event rule.
A.difference: Parent has a global maximum estimator and host C++ iteration. This introduces block-local accepted schedules, without altering equations.
A.falsifier: No materially useful end-to-end speedup, hidden interblock coupling, changed event counts/flags, or whole-organism differences beyond frozen transport criteria.

B.operation: Analytical weighted response of declared affine filter/receiver chains to timestamped events; retain event order and prefix queries. Nonlinear or recurrent receivers must retain a correct fallback until a separate error bound exists.
B.information: Physical event timestamps/amplitudes and declared linear operator, not behavioral outputs.
B.difference: Avoid sampling an unobserved late impulse with the same zero estimator; no claim that a generic nonlinear CNS can simply average it.
B.falsifier: Failure on late-event, equal-time-constant, prefix or noncommuting receptor controls; inability to apply to real dominant operators.

C.operation: Full voltage-gate Jacobian with Schur elimination of linear stage corrections, retaining all states.
C.difference: Cross derivatives absent from the discarded block-diagonal W are restored.
C.falsifier: Setup/stage work exceeds possible saved factorizations, or poor applicability across operators.

controls.exact: physical clocks, event counts, identities, flags
controls.promotion: Short full-organism screen first; only passing variants may consume longer trajectory budget. No full second speed claim without executing it.

selection: A first because measured native trial/commit still synchronizes twice per accepted substep; B independently tested against analytic/matrix exponential reference; C remains rival with published mathematical basis. Do not combine B into nonlinear real CNS without validation.
classification: Engineering, not a new biological mechanism. No stage3 admission inferred. No Codex subagents. ChatGPT documentary review is not independent GPU reproduction.
